blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Justice (DOJ) is wrapping up its review of the United States’ extradition request for Kingdom of Jesus Christ (KOJC) leader Apollo Quiboloy. Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida disclosed this during a press conference on Thursday.
